value.hook: Open before changing how cargo is wrapped or niced, shared-build's steps, or any recipe that runs cargo directly
value.title: Changing how pij builds are scheduled: the five copies of the rule (F186, #228)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Since F186 (Jordan, 2026-11-11), every pij cargo build and test runs under `nice -n 19` only: never `taskpolicy -b`, one build at a time (shared-build's lock), 4 jobs (.cargo/config.toml). A cargo test is one step; plan 209's --no-run split is gone.

The rule has copies that drift on their own. Change them together:
1. harness/scripts/shared-build.sh (header comment and run_cargo).
2. harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts. Besides the scheduling test, the jobs-cap and --then batch tests count cargo calls per command, so a change in steps breaks them too. Grep for the behaviour, not just the flag.
3. justfile `route-inventory-check`. It runs cargo directly, with its own wrapper copy, not through shared-build. Also the shared-build recipe comment.
4. AGENTS.md: resource-cost item 5 and the `just shared-build` paragraph.
5. .harness/extensions/checks/instructions.md (the route-inventory stage text).

docs/difficulties.md rows and docs/plans are history: add a note rather than rewriting them. shared-build.test.ts is vitest, so under C25 CI is its proof. Running shared-build.sh directly against a fake `cargo` that echoes `ps -o nice=` and its env is a quick local check.
